dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト); GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL-based, screen-driven subprogram with LINKAGE SECTION and CALL to ORCDBMAIN
evidence: MCP-STATUS / MCP-EVENT / MCP-FUNC / MCP-PUTTYPE patterns typical of ORCA middleware

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software — patient registration confirmation screen WID1
purpose.summary: This is a subprogram (screen component) in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles the confirmation screen WID1 for patient registration, evaluating MCP events (LINK, PUTG/CLICKED) and dispatching to initialization or screen-transition routines. It calls ORCDBMAIN to perform window PUT operations.

notable_features: Extremely high COPY count (64 copybooks) for screen layout and shared areas
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA parameters
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen navigation
CALL 'ORCDBMAIN' with MCP-FUNC='PUTWINDOW' for window management
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (decoded as latin-1 garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary ORCA MCP middleware
MCP-PUTTYPE set to 'JOIN' (corrected from 'BACK' per inline comment)
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese EUC encoding, displayed as garbled latin-1 in this context. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project. The 64 COPY statements pull in screen layout copybooks (W01.INC through WID2.INC). Only 1 PIC clause is visible in the source itself; the rest are in copybooks.
